description:
Configure Manager.io to track additional details on Sales Invoices. 

1. Navigate to 'Settings' and then 'Custom Fields'.
2. Create a new custom field named 'Customer PO Number'. Set its placement/form to 'Sales Invoices' and type to 'Single-line text' (or similar text option).
3. Create a second custom field named 'Vehicle Registration'. Set its placement/form to 'Sales Invoices' and type to 'Single-line text'.
4. Verify your work by opening a 'New Sales Invoice' form and ensuring both fields appear.

The business is Northwind Traders. You do not need to save a specific invoice, just configure the fields so they appear on the form.
